Leadership, Market Presence & Key Client Relationships

Leadership Team

Gaurav Sethi, SIOR Co-founder

With over 16 years of commercial real estate experience, Gaurav is a Founding Partner at Legion Realty Services, leading the firm’s Pune operations with a strong client-centric approach and deep market expertise. An Urban Planner by qualification, he previously worked with Kotak Mahindra Bank, where he helped establish and grow the Corporate Salary Accounts channel in Pune.

Jaideep Gaandhie MRICS, SIOR Co-founder

With over 23 years of commercial real estate experience, Jaideep is a Founding Partner at Legion Realty Services, leading the firm’s Bengaluru operations and playing a key role in its growth, client acquisition, and service delivery. Prior to co-founding Legion, he held leadership roles at Mahindra Lifespaces and Cushman & Wakefield, managing real estate portfolios for global clients including IBM, Nokia, Symantec, and Pfizer, and holds an MBA from Southampton Solent University, UK.

Dominant Leasing Volume:
41.7%

GCCs captured 41.7% of total H1 2026 office leasing (+14.2% YoY growth).

Drivers of the GCC Strategic Pivot:

  • Shift to Product OwnershipEvolving from traditional back-office delivery into the primary global digital and engineering "brain" of parent organizations.
  • Core Structural AdvantagesUnmatched competitive edge backed by India's vast talent pool, mature innovation ecosystem, and cost efficiency.
  • Existing Portfolio Capacity CrunchHigh physical office attendance creating space constraints across current enterprise footprints.
  • Accretive Headcount GrowthOngoing hiring expansion requiring long-term real estate footprint scaling.
